VeraGridEngine.Simulations.ShortCircuitStudies.short_circuit module

VeraGridEngine.Simulations.ShortCircuitStudies.short_circuit.safe_spsolve(system_matrix: csc_matrix, rhs: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], logger: Logger | None, context: str, fault_impedance: complex) → ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]] | None[source]

Solve a sparse linear system and report singular/non-finite states as errors.

Parameters:

  • system_matrix – Sparse system matrix.

  • rhs – Right-hand side vector.

  • logger – Logger where the numerical error must be reported.

  • context – Text identifying the short-circuit solve stage.

  • fault_impedance – Fault impedance used for the case.

Returns:

Solution vector, or None when the solve is unusable.

VeraGridEngine.Simulations.ShortCircuitStudies.short_circuit.short_circuit_3p(bus_idx: int, Ybus: csc_matrix, Vbus: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], Vnom: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[float64]], Zf: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], baseMVA: float, logger: Logger | None = None) → Tuple[ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]]][source]

Executes a 3-phase balanced short circuit study :param bus_idx: Index of the bus at which the short circuit is being studied :param Ybus: Admittance matrix :param Vbus: Voltages of the buses in the steady state :param Vnom: Nominal Voltages of the buses (kV) :param Zf: Fault impedance array :param baseMVA: Circuit base power (100 MVA) :param logger: Logger object (optional) :return: Voltages after the short circuit (p.u.), Short circuit power in MVA Computed as V = Vpre + V increment, where Vpre is the power flow solution and V increment is the fault contribution The short-circuit power is V_i^2 / Z[i,i], it will tend to infinity if the generator is ideal (r1 and x1 approach 0)

VeraGridEngine.Simulations.ShortCircuitStudies.short_circuit.short_circuit_unbalance(bus_idx: int, Y0: csc_matrix, Y1: csc_matrix, Y2: csc_matrix, Vbus: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], Vnom: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[float64]], Zf: ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], fault_type: FaultType, baseMVA: float, logger: Logger | None = None) → Tuple[ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]], ndarray[tuple[Any, ...], dtype[complex128]]][source]

Executes the unbalanced short circuits (LG, LL, LLG types)

Parameters:

  • bus_idx – bus where the fault is caused

  • Y0 – Admittance matrix for the zero sequence

  • Y1 – Admittance matrix for the positive sequence

  • Y2 – Admittance matrix for the negative sequence

  • Vbus – pre-fault voltage (positive sequence)

  • Vnom – nominal voltage (kV)

  • Zf – fault impedance

  • fault_type – type of unbalanced fault

  • baseMVA – base MVA (100 MVA)

  • logger – Logger (optional)

Returns:

V0, V1, V2 for all buses
